Visualization

Plotting functions to visualize sites, raw material distributions, topological properties, and spectral data.

ArcheoGra.ConNetw.plot_sites — Function
plot_sites(toml_file::String; output_dir::String = pwd(), overwrite::Bool = false)

Generates a map plot of ONLY the archaeological sites given in the corresponding TOML file.

Arguments

  • toml_file::String: Name or path of the setup .toml file.

Keywords

  • output_dir::String: Base directory to save the plots (defaults to current working directory).
  • overwrite::Bool: If false (default), throws an error if the directory exists.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.plot_material — Function
plot_material(toml_file::String; output_dir::String = pwd(), overwrite::Bool = false)

Generates a map plot visualizing the distribution and multiplicity of materials across sites.

Arguments

  • toml_file::String: Name or path of the setup .toml file.

Keywords

  • output_dir::String: Base directory to save the plots (defaults to current working directory).
  • overwrite::Bool: If false (default), throws an error if the directory exists.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.Haversine_plot_connections — Function
Haversine_plot_connections(graphen::AbstractArray; compare::Bool = true, output_dir::String = pwd())

Plots geographic lines representing connections between archaeological sites. Black edges represent the default model, red edges represent new material-driven connectivity, and cyan indicates component unification.

Arguments

  • graphen::AbstractArray: Nested matrix array corresponding to graph evaluation steps.

Keywords

  • compare::Bool: If true, differences between models are highlighted via multi-color representation. Defaults to true.
  • output_dir::String: Target export folder. Defaults to active user working location.

Output

  • Nothing: Executes physical system disk commits recording graphical maps.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.Haversine_plot_connections_Sources — Function
Haversine_plot_connections_Sources(graphen::AbstractArray; compare::Bool = true, output_dir::String = pwd(), overwrite::Bool = false)

Plots connections integrating archaeological sites and physical raw material sources.

Arguments

  • graphen::AbstractArray: Graph structure array containing sites, sources, and adjacency components.

Keywords

  • compare::Bool: Highlighting network variations based on materials versus base thresholds. Defaults to true.
  • output_dir::String: Standard export path setup. Defaults to current working directory.
  • overwrite::Bool: Grants delete and replace capabilities over the file structure. Defaults to false.

Output

  • Nothing: Persists visualization elements directly to disk (PDF execution).
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.plot_clusters — Function
plot_clusters(graphen::AbstractArray, cluster_vecs::AbstractArray, cluster_method::String; plot_paths::Bool = false, output_dir::String = pwd(), overwrite::Bool = false)

Plots clusters of archaeological sites and sources onto a geographic map using GMT.

Arguments

  • graphen::AbstractArray: List of graph entries containing site data and adjacency matrices.
  • cluster_vecs::AbstractArray: List of cluster assignments corresponding to the graphs.
  • cluster_method::String: Name of the clustering method used (utilized for titles and filenames).

Keywords

  • plot_paths::Bool: If true, lines representing the edges between nodes are drawn. Defaults to false.
  • output_dir::String: Base directory to save the plots. Defaults to the current working directory.
  • overwrite::Bool: If false (default), throws an error if the directory exists.

Output

  • Nothing: Saves the generated maps as PDF and PNG files in the specified output directory.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.smoothed_eigenvalue_dist — Function
smoothed_eigenvalue_dist(x::Number, eigenvalues::Vector{<:Number}; sigma::Number = 0.015)

Smoothed eigenvalue distribution for spectral plots using a Gaussian kernel. Based on "The Laplacian spectrum of neural networks" (S. de Lange, M. de Reus, M. van den Heuvel).

Arguments

  • x::Number: The evaluation point.
  • eigenvalues::Vector{<:Number}: The array of graph eigenvalues.

Keywords

  • sigma::Number: The bandwidth parameter. Defaults to 0.015.

Output

  • Float64: The computed smoothed density value at x.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.Lorentz_kernel — Function
Lorentz_kernel(x::Number, eigenvalues::Vector{<:Number}; sigma::Number = 0.03)

Calculates the Lorentz (Cauchy) kernel density for a given set of eigenvalues.

Arguments

  • x::Number: The evaluation point.
  • eigenvalues::Vector{<:Number}: The array of graph eigenvalues.

Keywords

  • sigma::Number: The bandwidth parameter. Defaults to 0.03.

Output

  • Float64: The computed density value at x.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.spectral_plots_comparison — Function
spectral_plots_comparison(num_vert::Int; num_edges::Int = 0, num_graphs::Int = 1000, kernel::Function = smoothed_eigenvalue_dist, sigma::Number = 0.015)

Creates spectral plots using a smoothed eigenvalue distribution. Eigenvalues are averaged over multiple iterations of simulated random graphs. Compared baseline models include Soft Random Geometric Graphs (SRGG), Barabási-Albert, and Watts-Strogatz.

Arguments

  • num_vert::Int: Number of vertices in the simulated graphs.

Keywords

  • num_edges::Int: Target number of edges for the baseline graphs. Defaults to 0.
  • num_graphs::Int: Number of graph instances to simulate and average. Defaults to 1000.
  • kernel::Function: Kernel density function to apply. Defaults to smoothed_eigenvalue_dist.
  • sigma::Number: Bandwidth parameter for the kernel. Defaults to 0.015.

Output

  • Tuple{Plots.Plot, Matrix{Float64}}: The generated plot object and a matrix containing the averaged eigenvalues for each model.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.archaeological_spectral_plots — Function
archaeological_spectral_plots(source_toml::String; num_graphs::Int = 100, kernel_and_par::Tuple{Function, Number} = (smoothed_eigenvalue_dist, 0.015), seed::Any = nothing, incl_sources::Bool = false, double_distance::Bool = false, output_dir::String = pwd(), overwrite::Bool = false)

Generates and evaluates the spectral evolution of archaeological networks as material-driven edges are added incrementally.

Arguments

  • source_toml::String: Filename or path to the configuration TOML file.

Keywords

  • num_graphs::Int: Number of baseline graphs to simulate for null model comparisons. Defaults to 100.
  • kernel_and_par::Tuple{Function, Number}: Tuple containing the kernel function and its bandwidth parameter. Defaults to (smoothed_eigenvalue_dist, 0.015).
  • seed::Any: Random seed for reproducibility. Defaults to nothing.
  • incl_sources::Bool: Indicates whether to include raw material source nodes. Defaults to false.
  • double_distance::Bool: Determines connection probability thresholds. Defaults to false.
  • output_dir::String: Target export folder. Defaults to the active user working directory.
  • overwrite::Bool: Grants file replacement privileges. Throws an error if set to false and the directory already exists. Defaults to false.

Output

  • Nothing: Persists generated plots directly to the local file system.
ArcheoGra.ConNetw.plot_network_robustness — Function
plot_network_robustness(prob_matrix::AbstractMatrix; name::String = "Graph", output_dir::String = pwd())

Plots a "spy plot" graphic interpreting edge probabilities derived from simulated network graphs.

Arguments

  • prob_matrix::AbstractMatrix: The density likelihood matrix evaluating historical connectivity points.

Keywords

  • name::String: Chart target label.
  • output_dir::String: Root path for visual rendering objects.

Output

  • Plots.Plot: Returns the generated plot object.
